Container.Name: hivemind-trainer
Container.Overview: The trainer for HiveMind's Lab → New model: fine-tunes a base model (QLoRA with Unsloth) on the Lab dataset and makes a GGUF that HiveMind puts into Ollama. HiveMind starts and watches the jobs; the trainer only runs while you train. Needs an NVIDIA GPU (16 GB is enough for 9B models). Point "Lab folder" at the lab folder inside HiveMind's appdata.

Config.Name: Trainer port
Config.Description: HiveMind talks to the trainer here (Lab → New model → Trainer address, e.g. http://your-server:8765).

Config.Name: Lab folder
Config.Description: The lab folder inside HiveMind's appdata: HiveMind puts the trainer scripts, its token and the datasets here; finished models come back here.

Config.Name: Model cache
Config.Description: Downloaded base models (Hugging Face cache) and training files.

Config.Name: Hugging Face cache
Config.Description: Where base models are kept, inside the model cache folder.

Config.Name: NVIDIA devices
Config.Description: Which GPU to use (all, or a GPU UUID).
